headline: Sources: Giants QB Jaxson Dart out for extended period
summary: Jaxson Dart's knee injury is more severe than originally anticipated, and the Giants QB could miss the rest of the season, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo.

headline: Packers lose RT Zach Bako-Bewele to season-ending surgery
summary: Packers RT Zach Bako-Bewele, considered the team's best offensive lineman, is set to undergo knee surgery that will sideline him for 8-10 months.

headline: Woman says she reported alleged 49ers impersonator to team in December
summary: A woman who says she is a victim in the FBI's fraud case against Daejon Love said she sent a "complaint/concern" to the Niners in December 2025, eight months before Love was arrested and charged with wire fraud and conspiracy to commit wire fraud.

headline: Sources: Bagent has concussion, leaving Bears' QB situation unclear
summary: Bears quarterback Tyson Bagent is in the NFL's concussion protocol, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport on Tuesday.

headline: Jets sign ex-Titans QB Will Levis, release Bailey Zappe
summary: The Jets have signed former Titans starting QB Will Levis to their practice squad and have released Bailey Zappe.

headline: Ian Rapoport reveals Case Keenum could start for Bears on MNF
summary: Ian Rapoport reveals Case Keenum could start for Bears on MNF
